body:
## Why
`src/cli.js` prints a hardcoded `ghk 0.1.0`. It will drift from `package.json`.

## What
- Read the version from `package.json` (resolve relative to `import.meta.url`, no build step, no dependency).
- `ghk version --json` returns `{ "version": "0.1.0", "node": process.version }`.
- Add `test/version.test.js` asserting the printed version equals `package.json`'s.

## Done when
`npm run lint && npm test` pass and `ghk version` matches `package.json`.
title: ghk version should read package.json instead of a hardcoded string
